summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end UI/UX testing of GuardRail Studio - first formal testing_agent_v3 pass. All 5 pages tested with real browser interactions. Backend API tests: 50/50 passing. Frontend UI tests: all core flows working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend API: GET /api/health returns proxy status UP, active upstream, Gemini configured indicator
Backend API: GET /api/upstream returns mode (mock/gemini), proxy_url, config_path
Backend API: GET /api/metrics returns current metrics (allow_total, redact_total, block_total)
Backend API: GET /api/policy returns policy config and raw_toml
Backend API: GET /api/audit-log returns paginated audit records
Backend API: POST /api/test-prompt with clean prompt returns decision=allow, HTTP 200
Backend API: POST /api/test-prompt with prompt injection returns decision=block, HTTP 403
Backend API: POST /api/test-prompt with email PII returns decision=redact, HTTP 200, pii_entities_found populated
Backend API: POST /api/test-prompt with credit card PII returns decision=redact with [CARD] token
Backend API: POST /api/test-prompt with SSN PII returns decision=redact with [SSN] token
Overview page: loads successfully with status strip showing proxy UP, active upstream (mock), Gemini configured (YES)
Overview page: 4 KPI cards render (Allowed: 8, Redacted: 12, Blocked: 8, P95 Latency: 0.25ms)
Overview page: Decision trends line chart displays real data with allowed/redacted/blocked series
Overview page: Recent activity feed shows real audit records with decision badges and request IDs
Test Console: page loads with upstream selector, role selector, message textarea
Test Console: 5 preset buttons present (Clean prompt, Prompt injection, Email PII, Credit card PII, SSN PII)
Test Console: Clean prompt preset returns decision=allow, HTTP 200
Test Console: Prompt injection preset returns decision=block, HTTP 403, reason mentions prompt injection
Test Console: Email PII preset returns decision=redact, HTTP 200, pii_entities_found populated
Test Console: Redaction proof tab shows 'What you sent' vs 'What the mock upstream actually received' with [EMAIL] token visible
Test Console: Credit card PII preset returns decision=redact with [CARD] token in redaction proof
Test Console: SSN PII preset returns decision=redact with [SSN] token visible
Test Console: Raw JSON tab displays full backend response
Test Console: Summary tab shows decision-specific one-liner
Policy Editor: page loads with 3 toggle sections (Prompt injection detection, PII detection & redaction, Toxicity classifier)
Policy Editor: All 7 PII entity checkboxes present (email, phone, credit_card, ssn, ip_address, api_key, aws_key) with replacement tokens displayed
Policy Editor: Toxicity classifier shows disabled state with note 'Requires an ONNX model to be published; leave disabled until then'
Policy Editor: Custom keyword rules section with 'Add rule' button
Policy Editor: Existing custom rule 'block-test-competitor' (testcompetitorxyz) visible
Policy Editor: Successfully added new custom rule with keywords 'forbidden, secret, confidential' and block message
Policy Editor: Validation error shown when rule name is empty (red alert: 'Policy validation failed: policy.rules[1].name must not be empty')
Policy Editor: After filling rule properly, 'Validate & save' button saves successfully
Policy Editor: Raw guardrail.toml preview updates in real-time
Policy Editor: Successfully removed custom rule and saved
Audit Log: page loads with all 5 table headers (Timestamp, Decision, Reason, Request ID, Latency)
Audit Log: 20 audit records displayed in table with color-coded decision badges (REDACTED=yellow, BLOCKED=red, ALLOWED=green)
Audit Log: Search box filters records by request_id/reason/code
Audit Log: Decision filter dropdown present ('All decisions')
Audit Log: Clicking a row opens detail drawer showing full audit record with request_id, timestamp, pipeline latency, total latency, reason, PII entities found, and raw JSON
Audit Log: Pagination controls (Previous/Next) present
Settings: page loads with 'Upstream LLM' section
Settings: Mock upstream card shows http://127.0.0.1:9000 with 'Active' indicator
Settings: Gemini card shows 'API key configured' with 'Switch' button

Settings: Proxy connection info section displays proxy URL (http://127.0.0.1:8080), metrics URL (http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics), config path (/app/guardrail/guardrail.toml), audit log path (/app/guardrail/guardrail-audit.ndjson)
Settings: Upstream switching from Mock to Gemini works - 'Upstream switched to gemini' toast appears, Gemini card shows 'Active'
Settings: Upstream switching from Gemini back to Mock works - 'Upstream switched to mock' toast appears, Mock card shows 'Active'
Settings: Toast notifications use Sonner component (proper toast, not raw red/green alerts)
Navigation: All 5 sidebar links present (Overview, Test a Prompt, Policy Editor, Audit Log, Settings)
Navigation: Clicking sidebar links navigates correctly between pages
Navigation: Active page shows selected state in sidebar
Integration: Custom keyword rule 'testcompetitorxyz' successfully blocks matching prompts in Test Console (decision=block, HTTP 403)
Integration: Custom keyword rule does not interfere with clean prompts (decision=allow)
No console errors detected on any of the 5 pages during normal navigation and interaction
